chunks: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Perform supererogatory prayers during the time of heedlessness, even if only with two light rak'ahs, for they bequeath the abode of honor."

key_terms.تُورِثَانِ: Cause one to inherit or attain
key_terms.دَارَ الْكَرَامَةِ: The abode of honor, meaning the blessed reward in the Hereafter
key_terms.سَاعَةِ الْغَفْلَةِ: A time of heedlessness when people are generally inattentive to worship

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for performing voluntary prayer during times of heedlessness?
ai.summary: This hadith encourages offering supererogatory salat (prayer) at times when people are generally heedless of worship. Even a small act, such as two light rak'ahs, carries immense spiritual value and leads to the abode of honor in the Hereafter.
